title: Chapter 14: the three decisions, and the plan's three gates
tries: Chapter 14's two figures. A card with the afternoon's three decisions on one line of time, every time and length read from the checked register at build. And the plan of three parts as three gates on the clock, each with its lock time as planned, and the minute it was set, read with git; drawn as planned, not as it turned out. Times in the picture only; no id or hash drawn.
